title: 05 Salt Ledger: editorial magazine index footer
strengths: A real idea only this brand would have: the footer set as the printed issue's contents page, with a double rule, a running head, a huge oxblood italic '23', roman-numeral sections, dotted leaders and page numbers
One typeface (Newsreader) in roman, italic and small caps does everything; two colours (ink, oxblood) on paper

Every line is specific: 'Thresholds · Autumn 2026 · 168 pages', 'Fiction · The Lighthouse Keeper's Daughter ... 38', 'Submissions · open till 1 Dec', 'ISSN 2977-0412', 'printed on uncoated paper four times a year'
fixes: The pull-quote under 'Thresholds' is a size step smaller than the index entries and could sit one step up

references.what: Sections grouped under one small label with the seal to one side; type does all the work, as here
A tiny centred legal line in serif on paper; our colophon line is in this register
Thin rules under lowercase column labels instead of boxes; our ruled section heads follow this
Editorial footer with a small top row of links and one large picture; shows the opposite route, image-led rather than index-led

changed: Warm cream, oxblood italics, the 248 px numeral and dotted leaders removed; cool near-white paper and ink set through the engine (warmth 12, cool neutralBase), oxblood kept for one job
Two faces through the engine: Newsreader (roman) for masthead and titles, Inter for links and data; one 14 px label style
Quiet index: current issue with one Subscribe action, three pieces with page ranges and bylines, newsletter row, four link groups on the contents' columns
One ownable object: the shelf, every issue since 2021 as a spine as thick as its page count, themes down the spine, the current issue the one oxblood spine, the next a dashed space
Facts corrected: pieces open on left-hand pages, issue numbering checked from spring 2021, ISSN with a wrong check digit removed
Layouts checked at 1440, 1100, 960, 800 and 390 px; phone frame re-rendered

facts: heading alignment (6 px) fixed after the final audit, checked by eye
Pairwise judging was not blind: the judge knew which side came from Mobbin

changed: Issue promo, contents list, newsletter and the 24-spine shelf removed (audit round 4: 'nothing leads')
The one signature element is the masthead fitted to the content width in oxblood, the brand colour's only job
Warm uncoated-paper ground #f5f3ee, outside the tokens on purpose (the cool neutral step read as software grey)
Prices taken out of the links; the fourth column renamed About; column headings aligned with the issue line
round4.after_audit: heading alignment (6 px) fixed after the final audit, checked by eye
